√krī 'buy'
present: [9.] krīṇā́ti krīṇīté etc. V.+ 
perfect: cikrāya cikriye 
[aorist: akraiṣīt akreṣṭa ]
future: [1.] kreṣyati kreṣyate etc. -- [2.] kretā 
verbal: krītá V.+ kretum E.+ krītvā́ AV.+ -krī́ya B.+ 
secondary: passive: krīyáte etc. B.+ -- intensive: cekrī- -- desiderative: cikrīṣate -- causative: krāpayati acikrapat 
derivatives: krayá AV.+ -krayaka E. -krayin E.+ krayya B.+ kráyaṇa B.+ krayaṇīya S. -krāyaka E.+ -krī AV.+ -krīti B. kretavya E.+ kretṛ E.+ kreya E.+

√krīḍ 'play'
present: [1.] krī́ḍati krī́ḍate etc. V.+ 
perfect: cikrīḍa cikrīḍe etc. B.+ 
[aorist: acikrīḍat akrīḍīt ]
future: [1.] krīḍiṣyati -- [2.] krīḍitā 
verbal: krīḍita E.+ krīḍitum -krīḍya 
secondary: intensive: cekrīḍ- -- desiderative: cikrīḍiṣa- -- causative: krīḍayati etc. S.+ krīḍāpayati 
derivatives: krīḍá V.+ krīḍā́ B.+ krīḍín V.+ krīḍana E.+ krīḍí RV.B. krīḍitṛ C. krīḍú RV. cikrīḍiṣā C. cikrīḍiṣu C.
